newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in after-hours trade on Wednesday after gains during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.3 yen per kg lower to 0.3 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark February finished 0.2 yen lower at 143.3 yen. Activity was buoyant with 11,701 lots traded.

During the day, the market was boosted by firmer prices in rubber-producing countries and the yen's weakness against the dollar, they said. "If overseas markets continue to firm, the benchmark February could test 145.00 yen this week," an analyst at a commodity broker said.
